keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «커다란 혜성이 지구를 향해 날아온다(문제)» 와 «김 선장이 지구를 구했다(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (a big comet is flying toward Earth) and the solution (Captain Kim saved the Earth). The green sentences are the answers.

opts: A big comet is flying toward Earth.
Captain Kim is lost in space.
evs: A big comet is flying toward Earth!
It is huge, icy, and very bright.
The comet turns and flies past Earth.
why: 커다란 혜성이 지구를 향해 날아오고 있어서 모두가 걱정해요.
A big comet is flying toward Earth, so everyone is worried.

qs.q: "The comet turns and flies past Earth." What does "flies past Earth" mean?
opts: goes by Earth and does not hit it
evs: Captain Kim gets into her fastest rocket.
She flies close to the comet.
why: 김 선장이 지구를 «saved» 구했어요. 그러니 혜성이 지구에 부딪히지 않고 옆으로 지나갔다는 뜻이에요.
Captain Kim saved the Earth, so the comet goes by Earth and does not hit it.

qs.q: How does Captain Kim save the Earth?
opts: She breaks the comet into small pieces.
She pushes the comet a little, so it turns away.
evs: Captain Kim pushes it with her rocket, just a little.
The comet turns and flies past Earth.
why: 김 선장이 로켓으로 혜성을 살짝 밀고(«Captain Kim pushes it...»), 혜성이 방향을 틀어 지구를 비껴가요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
Captain Kim pushes the comet a little with her rocket, and the comet turns and flies past Earth. You need both sentences.

ends: Captain Kim flies to the Moon for a new mission.
김 선장이 새로운 임무를 위해 달로 날아간다.
The people of Earth have a big party for Captain Kim.
지구 사람들이 김 선장을 위해 큰 파티를 연다.

write.src: “I think <u>Captain Kim is brave</u> because <u>she flies close to the comet</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.

chips.b: I can sleep with the light off
chips.label: brave

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because he is smiling)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because he is smiling)

img.cover: In dark space full of stars, a sleek red-and-white rocket with round windows gently pushes against the side of a huge glowing blue-white icy comet with a long shining tail, and Captain Kim, a woman with a short black bob, wearing a white space suit with orange stripes, holds the controls with a brave smile behind the front window.

scenes.1: In dark space, a sleek red-and-white rocket with round windows zooms close to a huge glowing blue-white icy comet with a long shining tail, and Captain Kim, a woman with a short black bob, wearing a white space suit with orange stripes, looks out the round window with wide eyes at the bright ice.
scenes.2: Far out in space, a huge glowing blue-white icy comet with a long shining tail turns away and flies past the blue planet Earth, while a sleek red-and-white rocket with round windows floats nearby and Captain Kim, a woman with a short black bob, wearing a white space suit with orange stripes, cheers with both arms up behind the window.

alt.2: The comet flies past Earth, and Captain Kim cheers.
